verdict.rationale: Viam's Registry supplies hardware drivers, so you don't need to write your own. You name a model in the config and viam-server pulls the driver from the Registry and initializes it automatically. You can search the catalog by manufacturer or hardware type (e.g. viam:ufactory:xArm6), and the pricing page advertises pre-built modules. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that reusable behavior/logic modules (not just hardware drivers) can be pulled from the Registry, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the Registry experience.
